events.title: Last U.S. Combat Troops Leave Vietnam
events.description: The last United States combat troops departed South Vietnam, following the Paris Peace Accords signed in January 1973. On the same day, Hanoi released the last of its acknowledged American prisoners of war.
events.significance: Marked the end of direct U.S. military involvement in the Vietnam War, a conflict that had deeply divided American society and reshaped U.S. foreign policy.

events.title: Terracotta Army Discovered in China
events.description: Farmers digging a well near Xi'an in Shaanxi Province uncovered fragments of life-sized clay soldiers guarding the tomb of Qin Shi Huang, the first emperor of unified China, who died in 210 BCE.
events.significance: One of the greatest archaeological finds of the 20th century, it revealed thousands of sculpted warriors and offered unparalleled insight into Qin dynasty military organization, craftsmanship, and burial practices. It is now a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

events.title: British North America Act Receives Royal Assent
events.description: Queen Victoria gave royal assent to the British North America Act, which united the Province of Canada (split into Ontario and Quebec), Nova Scotia, and New Brunswick into the Dominion of Canada.
events.significance: Created the legal foundation for the Canadian confederation, which took effect on July 1, 1867, and began Canada's evolution into an independent nation.

events.title: Battle of Towton
events.description: During the Wars of the Roses, Yorkist forces under Edward IV defeated the Lancastrian army near Towton in Yorkshire in a snowstorm on Palm Sunday. It is often considered one of the largest and bloodiest battles fought on English soil.
events.significance: The victory secured the throne for Edward IV and established the House of York in power, dealing a major blow to the Lancastrian cause of Henry VI.

events.title: Niagara Falls Stops Flowing
events.description: An ice jam in the upper Niagara River during a strong windstorm blocked the flow of water, causing the falls to run nearly dry for about 30 to 40 hours.
events.significance: A rare natural event that stunned locals, who walked on the exposed riverbed and recovered artifacts, illustrating the power of ice and weather on major geographic features.
